Menghuan Lake | Taipei Travel
s: At about 860 meters in elevation, Menghuan Lake is located at the southeast foothills of Qixing Mountain. A rare aquatic fern, Taiwan quillwort, grows in the Lake. It is a relatively low-latitude region for quillwort in the world. Aquatic fern, such as Taiwan quillwort, is very hard to find; to preserve the national treasure, Menghuan Lake has been set as an ecological preserving zone.
